prompt: Write 5 short claim log entries by an auto insurance adjuster for a side impact at intersection claim. Injury: neck strain. The claimant is represented by a lawyer. Start each entry on a new line with 'Entry 1:', 'Entry 2:' and so on. No names, dates or amounts. (Internal reference C-1137; do not mention it.)
text:
Entry 1: Claim opened for side impact at intersection. Insured reports the other vehicle entered the intersection against a red signal and struck the driver's side. Police report requested. Photos of both vehicles received from insured.

Entry 2: Claimant's counsel has filed a notice of representation. All further contact to go through the attorney's office. Claimant reports neck strain following the collision and has been advised to seek medical evaluation. Medical authorization forms sent to counsel.

Entry 3: Spoke with counsel regarding liability. Witness statement obtained from a pedestrian at the corner confirming the signal phase. Vehicle damage appraisal scheduled at the repair facility. Reserve set for bodily injury pending records.

Entry 4: Medical records received from the treating provider showing diagnosis of cervical strain with limited range of motion. Treatment plan includes physical therapy sessions over the next several weeks. Counsel requested a demand package, which will be reviewed once billing records are complete.

Entry 5: Independent medical review assigned to confirm treatment is consistent with reported injury. Liability position remains under review pending final police report. File flagged for supervisor review at next reserve meeting. No settlement discussions have taken place to date.
